audit.evidence: 'computed' when the audit ran on the pinned bytes; 'unavailable' when its evidence does not exist pre-G2 (e.g. G3 staging outputs). Unavailable is never a default pass: the registered run treats it as pass (more pairs, conservative for size) and the frozen 'unavailable_audit_fails' scenario treats it as fail; both are reported
audit.ladder: true unless the scaled-edit construction fails (A5.3.1 'audit-excluded')
audit.rotation: A5.3.3 outcome-free rotation audit of the donor edit's bytes (pass = true)
audit.timing: masks, audit flags and evidence are fixed when the payload is materialised after G0/G1 closure and before NULL-SIZE; they are never updated from G2 or G3 outcomes

consumer: scripts/a5_simulation.py (validate: --inputs-spec this file; run: INPUT --output SIZE.json [--scenario registered|variance_x2|unavailable_audit_fails])

donors.missing: a row lacking either record is not a donor; it is listed with its reason in provenance.missing; no imputation. An empty (family, tertile) donor cell leaves calibration unresolved (A5.3.2)
donors.records: data/evals/qwen3.5-0.8b/tf_v1/<id>/records.jsonl, primary run (repeat_id null); the reference is 'base' for roots and the actual predecessor (parent_id) for chain steps; both must pass src/wsp/eval/response_intervention.py:_reference_on_file with the same scoring identity (config_hash, model_revision, source_hash, device), as references.json checks
donors.rows: eligible inventory rows that are D3 development members with a TF-v1 primary record and a matched actual-predecessor record on file after G0/G1 closure

input_file.commit: its sha256, inventory and provenance enter docs/prereg/a5_manifests/nullsize/ (inputs_provenance.json) with the NULL-SIZE reports
input_file.format: JSON object (or NPZ with the same JSON as scalar Unicode 'payload', no pickle)

inventory.cutpoints: frozen from this inventory by scripts/a5_simulation.py:selection_cells; they must equal selection.json:procedural_freeze.cutpoints
inventory.source: docs/prereg/a5_manifests/components.jsonl rows with family in family_map (frozen selection inventory, A5.3.1); every such row is listed, eligible or not

payload_schema.donor_row: an inventory row plus audit [3] (explicit booleans) and audit_evidence [3] ('computed' | 'unavailable'); no residuals key

inventory_row.eligible: components.jsonl eligibility == 'eligible' (chair ruling A5.3.1, registered: predecessor-lost rows are ineligible)
inventory_row.norm: components.jsonl effective_norm (finite for eligible rows; may be null otherwise)

payload_schema.pair_order: row j of centred_noise/window_mask/donor_mean is donors[j]

provenance_layout: provenance = {'donors': {donor id: {edit_record_sha256, reference_id, reference_record_sha256, run_ids}}, 'missing': {inventory id: reason}}; record hashes are sha256 of the records.jsonl bytes

proxy.centring: within pair over its valid windows: centred_noise_i[w] = U_i[w] - mean_valid(U_i); donor_mean_i = mean_valid(U_i) is pinned separately (the donor effect)
proxy.contrasts: scripts/a5_simulation.py:contrasts; scales a = (1, 0.25, 0.5) for (rotation, ladder 0.25, ladder 0.5). Null: a_c * sigma_k * (donor_mean + block noise), one fair-coin sigma_k per simulated component per replicate shared by mean and noise of all three contrasts. Registered alternative: a_c * (|donor_mean| * sign(prediction_c) * B_k + block noise), one B_k per component, P(B=+1)=0.75. The resolution step (32 two-window blocks, 4,000 common paired draws) is applied to each contrast separately
proxy.definition: U_i[w] = y(W_i + D_i)[w] - y(W_i)[w]: per-window difference between the TF-v1 primary record of development edit i and the record of its actual predecessor (base for roots), same scoring identity and the same 64 windows
proxy.not_an_observed_rotation: no rotation record exists before G3; no rotation column is fabricated and predecessor data is never relabelled as a rotation. Null size and power are conditional on this surrogate and the sign-flip DGP; it is not an empirical certification of the rotation null
proxy.post_g2: POWER-AND-YIELD uses the identical payload file (same sha256), never G3 contrasts
proxy.shared: one donor block (mean and centred noise) per slot is shared by all three contrasts; the outer 32-block panel draw and the resolution draws are common to all slots and contrasts
proxy.status: REGISTERED (chair ruling A5.3.2(ii), 7 Nov 2026; Board A accepted with caveats, docs/reviews/council/board-a-a5-package-2026-11-07.md item 4)

residuals.field: extra.mean_nll (nats per valid next token; each window has n_tokens 1023, so the mean over windows is token-weighted)
residuals.masks: window_mask[j, w] is False where either record lacks window w or its value is nonfinite; centred_noise[j, w] is then NaN/null. A pair with any masked window has all three simulated contrasts missing (counted as audit/nonfinite failures, removed from the resolved denominators, never imputed or replaced)
residuals.window_order: item_id '0'..'63' = text_groups.json windows in order; the simulation forms the 32 two-window blocks (2k, 2k+1)

scenarios.unavailable_audit_fails: unavailable audit evidence counted as failure
scenarios.variance_x2: centred noise doubled, donor means unchanged (variance inflation)

status: specification; this file holds no data. The payload is materialised after G0/G1 closure from the closed snapshot (snapshot.json) by scripts/a5_nullsize_inputs.py; its validation and the NULL-SIZE reports are in nullsize/ (A5.3.2, A5.11). Registered proxy: chair ruling A5.3.2(ii) and the A5 freeze-prep amendments (7 Nov 2026)
